name: MoveColumnsNode
label: Move Columns
description: Reorders columns in a data table. Specify the desired column order as a comma-separated list; any columns not listed are appended at the end in their original order.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table whose columns to reorder.

fields.name: ColumnOrder
fields.label: Column Order
fields.description: Comma-separated column names in the desired order.
